versions.content: A call to J1939Nm_Reque stIndication shall trigger transmission of a CannotClaimAddress PG after a delay calculated according to [SWS_J1939Nm _00068] when the addressed NodeChannel is in sub state ‘AcLost’ of state ‘Offline’.
